videos.script: Three hundred pages at seventy a day. How many days? A program finds out by doing the same thing again and again, and stopping at the right moment. {{kinds}} This lesson is about loops. Java has three, and they differ in when they check whether to go on. One checks first, one checks after, and one counts. {{order}} The counting loop's header looks like it runs left to right. It does not, and the diagram shows the order it really runs in. {{each}} Then the loop over every element, which cannot go out of bounds, and the one thing it cannot do. {{break}} Last, leaving a loop early. A search that finds the book and then keeps looking, and the label that stops it. By the end you can pick the loop that says what you mean, and spot the loop that never ends.
